<div class="card-body">
'''Stalker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ストーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">6名のパイロット、8名の乗客、2台のビークル、4機のタイを搭乗させられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。同じ星系の位置にプローブ・ドロイドをフォースを消費せずに配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Stalker-PSA-102220479.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">元はアウター・リムで新たな惑星を征服する任務に就いていた。エコー基地を発見したプローブ・ドロイドを送りだした。後にデス・スコードロンに転属となった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stalker.

'''Card text:'''
May carry 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. Probe droids may deploy free to locations of the same system.

'''Lore:'''
It was originally assigned to conquer new planets in the Outer Rim. It launched the probe droid that found Echo Base. It was later reassigned to Death Squadron.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' TIEs are タイ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Stalker]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
